title: Status button clears the queue and fetches a fresh report with every open question, led in by the period it covers

requirements.text: Pressing the status button discards every pending (unheard) item and any arrival on screen; held answers are kept
requirements.check: WalkPlanTest/Link: after statusRefresh pending is empty; manual: Pixel logcat diag 'status: cleared N'

requirements.text: The request asks for every project's current state and every open question waiting on TJ, even ones told before, and names the period since the last report
requirements.check: WalkPlanTest for statusRequest text containing the period and 'every open question'

requirements.text: The walk opens with a time-aware lead-in naming the period, e.g. 'Here's your status report from last night'
requirements.check: WalkPlanTest for periodPhrase (overnight, this morning, last N hours); eye on Pixel

requirements.text: Replies from before the press are not walked after it
requirements.check: unit: a reply with t before the clear mark is not merged
